pages.title: Mirror Antibody
pages.text: An antibody built mirror-handed, the one shape that fits a mirror microbe. Use it on yourself: held safe from the Mirror Plague of the Antiverse's Mirror Microbes for three in-game days (no other ward holds it). Made in the Mirror Culture Vat.
Made in $(item)Mirror Culture Vat$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Mirror Life.
